title: Intersectional experience in public organizations
summary: How race, gender, generation, representation, inclusion, and organizational justice influence burnout, extra-role work, voice, and public-service careers.
body_html:
This research examines how race, gender, generation, representation, inclusion, and organizational justice influence burnout, extra-role work, voice, and public-service careers.

The work emphasizes intersectional analysis and the institutional conditions that produce equitable workplaces and services.
